note: Shared accept/reject corpus for the dataviz block validator. Run through BOTH implementations by backend/tests/test_dataviz_contract.py: the backend's parse_dataviz and the frontend's parseDataViz, the latter executed under node by importing frontend/app/chat/datavizContract.ts. 'expect' is the correct verdict both sides must agree on; a fixture the two sides disagree about fails the test.

fixtures.name: bare_1e999_in_label_cell

fixtures.name: bare_1e999_in_unused_key
fixtures.why: the same in a key the renderer never reads

fixtures.name: deeply_nested_payload
fixtures.why: nesting past the shared depth limit: json.loads raises RecursionError on a much deeper payload and a recursive walk would overflow V8's stack, so both sides treat it as malformed

fixtures.name: huge_integer_cell
fixtures.why: a bare integer literal too wide for a float: JSON.parse overflows it to Infinity and the browser refuses it, while Python's float() and math.isfinite() RAISE OverflowError, which used to escape parse_dataviz and fail the whole chat request

fixtures.name: huge_integer_value_column
fixtures.why: an integer literal too wide for a double is a fine Python int but reaches the browser as Infinity, so the block is malformed on both sides

fixtures.name: huge_integer_in_unused_key
fixtures.why: an integer literal too wide for a double is an exact finite int in Python but reaches the browser as Infinity, so the whole payload is walked rather than only the value column

fixtures.name: trailing_exotic_whitespace
fixtures.why: exotic whitespace after the closing fence: it changes how much text a side consumes, which is why the contract test compares the match span and not only the verdict

fixtures.name: num_json_overflow
fixtures.why: a bare JSON number that overflows to infinity is valid JSON syntax, so it survives json.loads; the finite check in _as_float is what stops it, and JSON.parse overflows it to Infinity which the browser already refused

fixtures.name: num_json_infinity
fixtures.why: a raw Infinity literal is not a number

fixtures.name: json_infinity_in_title
